messages:
anya: RFC follow-up: proposing a 'weave fallback' pattern. Instead of a single backup, weave micro-traffic lanes into multiple fallbacks and a local degraded path so quality drops are gradual and tails don't spike. Basic idea: when baseline loses quality, instead of shifting 100% -> 0%, carve N micro-lanes (0.1% - 2%) and allocate them across candidates. Thoughts?

gopal: I like it. Main operational asks: an off-hot-path decision plane, signed weight blobs, cost leash per-tenant, and a minimum dwell time for any weight change to avoid oscillation.

lina: Observability: we need per-variant p50/p95 latency, error-rate, and a quality_signal. Also a rollup metric that shows effective quality for the route. Emit audit events for any weight change > 0.2%.

ops-bot: :information_source: canary started id=cnr-17495 service=text-gen baseline=v2 window=12m

anya: Implementation sketch: fallback-broker consumes sampled telemetry (lat/err/quality), runs policy to compute a weight vector, and publishes compact signed blobs to router pubsub. Routers are simple caches that validate generation+sig+ttl and apply. Keep broker decisions eventual consistent within a small SLO slack.

gopal: Algorithm sketch: start with micro-lanes distributed evenly, monitor a composite score (quality_penalty + latency_penalty), then gradually re-weight lanes with proportional steps. Use exponential backoff if regression detected. Enforce cost_budget (cents/min) and quality_budget (max tolerable delta). Reservoir counters prevent single-request flips.

lina: Sticky sessions: weave hurts KV locality. Add session_affinity token support with an affinity_window (N requests) for latency-sensitive routes. Also add a variant-drain policy to quietly reassign affinity when a variant is retired.

anya: Debugging hooks: broker exposes /weave/explain?req_id=... returning which rules fired, current weight vector, and small metric snippets. Also a read-only /weave/effective-weights for oncall.

gopal: Pubsub message shape suggestion (compact JSON string): {"route":"R","weights":[{"v":"v2","w":0.96},{"v":"v1-quant","w":0.02},{"v":"local-cpu","w":0.02}],"gen":123,"ttl":60,"sig":"..."} Router validates gen and sig.

lina: Emergency paths: add a synchronous control-plane flag emergency_abort that routers check and instantly revert to configured fallback (or full kill). Also add a safe-mode which drains micro-lanes quickly but over a short fixed window to avoid sudden cost spikes.

anya: I'll draft an RFC addendum with: DeploymentSpec.fallback (mode=weave, variants[], cost_budget, min_dwell_ms, affinity_window), broker pubsub contract, telemetry contract (lat/err/quality/cost), algorithm pseudocode, and a short oncall runbook. Target: circulate by Friday EOD. Ping me with edge cases or sample profiles to include. :pray:
